TOML 0.2.5

为 Nanobug 本轮宿主整合重新构建并发布版本包；本版本仅提升发行版本，未增加插件业务功能。

通过公开 `--plugin-package` 构建及 `--plugin-check` 完整校验。插件独立安装，宿主安装包不随附插件。

- ZIP：`toml-0.2.5.zip`
- SHA-256：`5d041fd9e431ba402685e69f869d18ef4578a312b9f89a57f3b0fdbd5b7c86d0`
- 宿主：[v0.1.0-internal.20261103](https://github.com/Nanobug-Editor/Editor/releases/tag/v0.1.0-internal.20261103)

源码提交：`55034f72267dd5605a3a2db8b7bd7cb71663edee`

TOML 0.2.4，与 [Nanobug 内部测试版 0.1.0-internal.20261102.2](https://github.com/Nanobug-Editor/Editor/releases/tag/v0.1.0-internal.20261102.2) 配套验证的独立插件包。

通过当前公开 SDK 的构建或声明资源准入；保留现有安装 ID、权限和能力声明。

声明式语法资源包准入通过，未附带空 WASM 组件。 所有包均通过宿主公开 `--plugin-package` 与 `--plugin-check`。这不代表全部交互和语言服务器矩阵均已重验。语言工具及其运行环境继续按插件已有授权流程准备。

源码：[固定提交](https://github.com/Nanobug-Editor/TOML/commit/9c6dd67905ad28b83b9df987827e6191650ee5df) `9c6dd67905ad28b83b9df987827e6191650ee5df`。
公开 SDK 来源：`Nanobug-Editor/Editor@845e2f95389457f7635a913fe670e4a9c3293027`。

下载 `toml-0.2.4.zip`，在编辑器插件管理器中安装；附件 `.sha256` 可用于完整性校验。

SHA-256：`3f3a13ef0541d9960cac91c96f7bcac5368ab68f00945e2ea844ff1e98090c08`

市场目录收录和版本索引继续单独审核，本次不自动批准或更新 registry。

# TOML for Nanobug 0.2.3

- Publish the existing plugin from its independent official repository using the pinned public Nanobug SDK.
- Preserve installation ID `toml`, settings and private data; include standalone build instructions and the original license notices.
- This release changes distribution metadata and packaged documentation. It does not redesign plugin business behavior.

Source commit: `a1a4677118403ac01e6a0fd2f667cfa788aa9bd2`  
Public host / SDK: `b77e6317bf7e3d3d3d0fe9490cabd362d266e0a5`  
ZIP SHA-256: `2b3dabe0b2f67b2ed2440fe5eb8e7ac2b3e408105accc2f7bbdc9a2ccf6ebeed`

The checksum covers the complete published ZIP. Later rebuilds may produce different bytes and must not replace this attachment. Marketplace admission requires a separate reviewed PR.

The repository name now follows the maintainer's `X-for-Nanobug` naming convention. The source tag, installation ID, version, ZIP filename and complete ZIP bytes are preserved from the verified release.
